creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`muster window` now names every daemon this window is attached to, with its socket, what it holds, and whether Muster started it or adopted one that was answering (`a_28YghIUw2`). That is the half that makes ending a session deliberate. It cannot answer the other half of the same question: **which daemons are on this machine that no window is attached to.**

Those are the ones that accumulate. Measured on 2026-08-18: twenty herdr daemons alive, nineteen holding nothing, one holding somebody's work - and the live one was neither the oldest nor the youngest, so sorting by age picks wrong. `./dev --doctor` answers it for this repo's own tooling by walking pids to sockets with `lsof -a -p <pid> -U` and dialing each one back, which works and is a build script rather than something a person running Muster has.

What would make it Muster's: a record of the daemons Muster has started - the socket, when, and when it was last attached to - written where a later launch can read it. `daemon.starting` already logs the socket and the config, so the run log is most of the data; what it is not is a file with a shape somebody can rely on across launches.

Worth deciding before building:

- **Where it lives, and what happens when it is wrong.** A daemon in the record that is not answering is either gone or unreachable, and the file cannot tell those apart - so the record has to be a hint that is checked, never an answer.
- **Whether a person or an agent reads it.** `muster daemons` as a verb, or a section of `muster window`, or only the quit sheet. The census only pays for itself where somebody is about to end something.
- **What it must not become.** Automatic reaping is refused on `a_28YghIUw2` and stays refused: a process holding somebody's work is the wrong thing to reap on a schedule, in a tool built on the promise that it will not.

Not urgent. The hazard it addresses is real and rare, and the deliberate half - knowing what *this* window would end - is done.
title: 🗂️ Muster knows the daemons it started, but only the ones this window is using
